subject: Re: Fallback fee structure, trial SLO & pilot pricing
messages:
From: Claire Wong <claire@brightcart.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@brightcart.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask: fallback fees + short pilot SLO

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the platform looks promising. Before we get finance and legal deeper, two practical asks from our ops and procurement teams:

1) If we need to fail over from your hosted model to a cheaper regional model during capacity spikes, how do you typically bill the fallback window? We want a predictable monthly charge we can budget for.

2) We're open to a 60-day pilot with a defined SLO (99.5% uptime for inference per calendar month). For the pilot, can you offer a reduced on-call / escalation fee and a one-time onboarding discount?

I've attached our procurement checklist (ops@brightcart.com copied). Looking for a short note on the fallback fee approach and a rough pilot price band so we can put together an internal recommendation.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Wong
Head of Platform, BrightCart
Attachment: brightcart_procurement_checklist.pdf (PDF, 45KB)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Claire Wong <claire@brightcart.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: fallback fees + short pilot SLO

Claire — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful. Quick answers up-front, then we'll follow with a small proposal: 

- Fallback billing: we offer a "fallback reserve" SKU. It's a fixed monthly fee that covers up to X concurrent fallback QPS and a per-token delta when fallback is actually used. The intent is to keep budgeting simple rather than unpredictable overage spikes.

- Pilot SLO: a 60-day pilot at an SLO of 99.5% is doable. For pilots we normally discount the on-call retainer by 50% and waive the onboarding fee if you commit to an initial monthly usage band.

Kimberly, can you draft a short matrix for BrightCart with 3 fallback bands (regional fallback only / regional+quantized variant / full fallthrough to hosted backup) and pilot pricing? Jordan, I think we'll want a written note on how escalation windows work during the pilot (who responds, escalation tiers).

I'll put a compact SLA draft together and share.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: (none)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Claire Wong <claire@brightcart.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Initial ask: fallback fees + short pilot SLO — proposed bands

Claire/Priyom — moving this forward. See the quick pricing matrix below and the attached spreadsheet with line-item economics (Oncall_Band_Pricing.xlsx). This is phrased to make budgeting simple for procurement.

Fallback bands (monthly):
- Band A (regional fallback only): $2,500/month reserve + $0.0025 per fallback token used (covers up to 3 fallback nodes).
- Band B (regional + quantized variant): $5,000/month reserve + $0.0018 per fallback token (recommended for sustained tail traffic).
- Band C (full fallthrough to hosted backup): $9,500/month reserve + $0.0010 per fallback token (lowest per-token delta).

Pilot pricing (60 days):
- Onboarding: waived if BrightCart commits to Band A or B for minimum 2 months after pilot ends.
- On-call retainer during pilot: $1,250/month (50% pilot discount from standard $2,500).
- One-time trial credit: $10k platform usage credit applied to first monthly invoice.

Escalation note: during the pilot we provide a single primary on-call (Redwood SE) with a 4-hour response target for Sev 1s and a secondary engineering contact within 8 hours. Post-pilot, response windows roll to standard tiers per committed band (see spreadsheet).

Attachment: Oncall_Band_Pricing.xlsx (Excel, 36KB)

Happy to adjust numbers if procurement needs different anchors.

— Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Wong <claire@brightcart.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Initial ask: fallback fees + short pilot SLO — proposed bands

Thanks Kimberly — that matrix is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from procurement/ops: 

1) Band A looks like the most likely entry point for us. Can you reduce the reserve to $1,800/month if we commit to a 3-month post-pilot minimum? That smooths our budget cadence.

2) For the on-call retainer during the pilot: Ops wants the option to pay per-incident instead of a retainer if incidents are rare. Suggestion: keep the discounted $1,250/month retainer as Plan 1, or Plan 2 = $350 per Sev1 incident (with a $2,000 cap/month). Can you confirm per-incident coverage (what counts as Sev1) and whether the cap includes escalation to engineering?

3) Legal asked about fallback reporting detail — we need daily instrumentation logs for any fallback events during the pilot (time, tokens, region). Is that available in your console or as a daily export?

If you can confirm those three items we can push this to our procurement committee for a quick PO.

Best,
Claire
Attachment: (none)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Claire Wong <claire@brightcart.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: RE: Initial ask: fallback fees + short pilot SLO — proposed bands

Claire — appreciate the concrete asks. Summary / commitments below so procurement has something to sign: 

1) Band A reserve: we can accept $1,800/month if BrightCart signs a 3-month post-pilot commitment (total minimum term = pilot + 3 months). We'll include the reserve + per-token delta as described.

2) On-call options during pilot: we will offer either
   - Plan 1: discounted retainer $1,250/month (covers one primary SE + on-call triage) or
   - Plan 2: per-incident $350 per Sev1 (Sev1 defined as complete inference outage impacting >90% of traffic for >5 minutes). Per-incident plan has a $2,000 cap/month and if capped, additional incidents bill at the standard $2,500/month retainer pro rata. Escalation to engineering is included in both options; exceptions for scheduled maintenance are excluded.

3) Fallback reporting: yes — during the pilot we will provide a daily CSV export delivered to a secure S3 bucket (fields: timestamp, request_id, tokens, region, fallback_path) plus a dashboard tile in your console for realtime visibility. We'll include sample output in the SLA draft.

Next steps:
- I will upload a short SLA addendum and a DocuSign packet for the pilot (includes the 3-month post-pilot commit option).
- Kimberly will attach the final Oncall_Band_Pricing.xlsx with the agreed $1,800 Band A anchor.

If that sounds good I'll send the DocuSign link and an estimated invoice for the first month's reserve (pro-rated).

Thanks — looking forward to working with you.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
